# The English Football League (EFL)

> The official home of English professional football outside the Premier League, covering the Championship, League One, League Two, and cup competitions.

The EFL is the second-tier professional football league system in England, organizing three divisions and multiple cup competitions. The site provides comprehensive coverage of matches, standings, fixtures, news, and viewing information across all competitions.

## Key Topics

- English Football League
- Championship
- League One
- League Two
- Carabao Cup
- EFL Trophy
- League Standings
- Match Fixtures
- Play-offs
- Sky Sports+
- iFollow
- Match Updates
- Club Coverage
- Football Governance
- Vertu Trophy

## Core Content

- [Homepage](https://www.efl.com): Official EFL homepage with live standings, upcoming fixtures, and Carabao Cup coverage

## News & Updates

- [News Hub](https://www.efl.com/news): Latest EFL news covering match updates, Championship, League One, League Two, and playoff coverage

## Viewing Guide

- [How to Watch and Follow the EFL](https://www.efl.com/how-to-watch): Complete guide to watching EFL matches via Sky Sports+, NOW, iFollow, and international streaming options
